figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3. Demonstration of the effect of weight baseline. The orange and blue curves represent the probability pθ (o|q) before and after update, and the magenta arrows represent the weights. (a) When the batch size is large, the distribution mode coverage is good. Though bad responses have positive weights, the correct ones have larger weights to push the distribution updates in the right direction. (b) When the batch size is small, some modes (e.g., the good one in the middle) may not be sampled. Without weight baseline subtraction, the dominant positive weights of the bad responses lead to wrong update directions. (c) With weight baseline subtraction, the bad responses will appropriately be penalized, leading to the desired update direction.

color.semantic_mapping: 橙/蓝为 old/new probability，洋红为 weights，黑色 ×/○ 为 Bad/Good。

final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文按「跨任务 headline → distribution target 直觉 → small-batch 机制 → 全条件结果矩阵 → baseline/效率消融 → 附录训练、超参与 entropy 复核」组织视觉证据，以矢量曲线、低饱和类别色和局部冗余编码支撑方法到结果的闭环。
